mentions.name: Custom music visualizer app
mentions.description: A custom music visualizer application that renders stylized visuals for electronic/ambient music, giving the user more control over the final results than existing visualizer tools. It pairs a rendering engine with the user's songs to produce complementary music videos, ranging from a basic stylized proof of concept to more complex visualizations.
mentions.problem: Existing music visualizer tools lacked the control needed to better complement the author's electronic/ambient music and achieve their creative vision.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a custom music visualizer application the past few weeks.

In my free time I produce electronic/ambient music and I've been unhappy with the existing visualizer tools and wanted something that gave me more control over the final results
